title: Convex MCP Server
summary: Let your coding agent inspect a Convex deployment's tables, data, logs and functions through the Convex CLI's MCP server, with write tools turned off.
description: The Convex CLI ships an MCP server that starts with npx and talks to your project's deployment. The agent can list tables and schemas, page through documents, run read-only queries and read recent function logs.
This setup passes the documented --disable-tools flag to remove run, envSet and envRemove, so the agent can look at your backend but cannot call mutations or change environment variables.
Production deployments stay off by default. Convex asks for an explicit dangerous flag to enable them, and this setup does not add it.
useWhen: Check what is really stored in a table while you debug a query
Read the last function errors after a failed deploy
Compare a schema with the types you wrote in your code
Find slow or failing functions from the health insights

mcp.name: convex
access: Reads tables, documents, function metadata and logs from your development deployment
Environment variable values can be read with envGet and envList, so keep secrets out of dev
Cannot run functions or set and remove environment variables with the tools disabled here

example.prompt: List my Convex tables, then show the five newest documents in messages and the last errors from the logs.
example.result: Tables: users, messages, channels. The five newest messages are listed with their channelId and author. Logs show two sendMessage failures: a validation error for an empty body.

faq.question: How do I limit it to one deployment?
faq.answer: Set the CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY environment variable before starting the server. Convex notes that the insights tool is unavailable when you do.

faq.question: How do I point it at production?
faq.answer: Convex requires the --dangerously-enable-production-deployments flag, and offers --cautiously-allow-production-pii for data reads. Leave both off unless you accept that risk.

faq.question: Which tools can I switch off?
faq.answer: The flag takes data, envGet, envList, envRemove, envSet, functionSpec, insights, logs, run, runOneoffQuery, status and tables, separated by commas.

access: Reads data and logs from your Convex development deployment
Write tools are disabled in this setup
